chapter.verse: Hih thu khit, Jew mite' pawi khat om a, Jerusalem ah Jesu paito hi.
Tu-in Jerusalem khua Tuu Kongpi gei ah talap nga a nei, Hebrew-kam ah Bethzatha a kici bual khat om hi.
Talapte sungah khuamulo, khelbai, pumzaw cih bangin cina tampi om hi. (Amaute in bualtui kilawh ding ngak uh hi.)
(A hang pen a hun khat ciangin Topa' vanmi khat hong kumsukin tui hong lok thei zel a, tui kilawh khit a ngap masa peuhpeuh natna a neih peuhpeuh dam hi.)
Tua lai-ah a cinat zawh kum sawmthum-le-giat a phazo mi khat om hi.
Jesu in tua mipa a lup mu a, zong sauvei om khinzo cih a theih ciangin, “Na dam nuam hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Cinapa in, “Sya aw, tui a kilawh ciangin bual sungah kei hong koih ding mi kuamah nei lo ka hih manin ka zuat laitak kei' ma-in midang khat na tuaksuk ta hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Tho inla na kisialna taal la-in lampai in,” ci hi.
Tua mipa zong thakhat thu-in dam pah a, a kisialna taal la-in lampai hi. (Tua ni pen Sabbath ni ahi hi).
Tua hi a, Jew mite in damna a ngah mipa' kiangah, “Tuni pen Sabbath ahih manin na kisialna taal na puak ding phaltheih hilo hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, “Kei hong damsakpa, tua mipa in, ‘Na kisialna taal pua inla lampai in,’ hong ci hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Nang' kianga ‘Na lupna puanlom pua inla lampai in,’ hong ci mipa kua ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Ahih hangin damna a ngah mipa in kua cih thei lo hi. A hang pen tua mun ah mihonpi a om ciangin Jesu na kihemkhia khin ahih man hi.
Tua nungah Jesu in biakinnpi sungah tua mipa mu ahih manin, “En dih in, na dam ta hi. Nang' tungah a siazaw khatpeuh hong pian loh nadingin mawhna bawl nawn kei in,” ci hi.
Tua mipa zong paikhia a, amah a damsakpa Jesu ahihlam Jew mite' kiangah va gen hi.
Hih pen Jesu bawlsiat ding Jew mite' kipatna thu ahi hi. A hang pen Jesu in hih thute Sabbath ni-in bawl ahih man hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Ka Pa in tu ciangdong nasem ahih manin kei zong a sem ka hi hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
Hih thu hangin Jew mite in Jesu that nuam semsem uh hi. A hang pen Jesu in Sabbath palsat bek thamlo, amahmah Pasian tawh kikimsakin Pasian nangawn ama' pianna Pa ci-in lo ahih man hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah Tapa in ama' thu-in bangmah sem theilo a, Pa' sep a muh teng bek sem thei hi. A hang pen Pa' sep peuhpeuh Tapa in zong sem hi.
Pa in Tapa it a, ama' sep khempeuh Tapa lak hi. Lamdang na sak nadingun hihte sanga a lianzaw thute zong lak lai ding hi.
A hang pen Pa in misite thosakin nuntakna a guat mah bangin Tapa in zong ama' deih peuh nungtasak ding hi.
Tua banah Pa in kuama' tungah thu khen lo a, thukhenna khempeuh Tapa' tungah vaipuak ap hi.
Tua pen mi khempeuh in Pa a zahtak uh bang lianin Tapa zong a zahtak nading uh ahi hi. Tapa a zahtak lo peuhpeuh Tapa a sawl ahi Pa a zahtak lo ahi hi.
Maantak diktak kong cihin ah ka thugen za-in kei hong sawlpa a um peuhpeuh tawntung nuntakna nei ahih manin thukhenna thuak lo ding hi. Amah pen sihna pan nuntakna lamah a galkah khin ahi hi.
“Maantak diktak kong cihin ah misite in Pasian' Tapa' aw a zak ding uh hunlenai khat hong tung ding a, tu-in zong a tung hita hi. Tua aw a za mite nungta ding hi.
A hang pen Pa in ama' sungah nuntakna a neih mah bangin Tapa zong ama' sungah nuntakna a neih theih nading thu guan hi.
Thukhenna a piak theih nadingin zong Mihing' Tapa' tungah uktheihna thu guan khinzo hi.
Hih thu lamdang sa kei un. A hang pen hankhuk sunga om khempeuh in ama' aw a zak uh hunlenai khat hong tung ding a,
amaute hong pusuakin gamtat hoihte pen nuntak thawhkikna ah, gamtat siate pen thukhen thawhkikna ah, tung ding uh hi.
“Keima' thu-in bangmah ka sem thei kei hi. Ka zak bangin thu ka khen a, keima' thukhenna thutang hi. A hang pen keima' ut thu ci lo-in kei hong sawlpa' deihna zui ka hih man hi.
Keima' thu kei bek in teci a pang ka hihleh ka teci panna a maan hilo hi.
Keima' thu teci a pang dang khat om a, keima' thu ama' teci panna thumaan ahihlam ka thei hi.
John' kiang mi na sawl uh a, amah in thumaan thutak thu teci pang khin hi.
Hih thute kong genna pen mihing' piak theih teci ka ngah man hilo-in hotkhiatna na ngah nading uh-a hong gen ka hizaw hi.
Amah pen meivak a kuang a taang khat hi a, tawlkhat sung ama' meitaang nuai-ah nopsak ding na ut uh hi.
Ahih hangin John' a sangin a lianzaw teci khat ka nei hi. A hang pen tangtut dinga Pa' hong piak, tu mahmah-a ka sep laitak ahi nasepte in keima' thu, kei pen Pa' sawl ka hihna thu, teci pang uh hi.
Kei hong sawlpa Pa mahmah in zong keima' thu teci pang hi. Ama' aw na za ngeikei uh a, ama' melpuak zong na mu ngeikei uh hi.
Na sung uhah zong ama' thu teeng lo hi. A hang pen ama' sawlpa na um kei uh hi.
Pasian' Laibupi tungtawnin tawntung nuntakna kingah ci-in na upmawh manun tua laibupi limtak na entel uh a, tua ii hong pulak pen keima' thu mah hinapi
nuntakna ngah nadingin keima' kiangah nong pai nuam kei uh hi.
Mite' kiangpan minpha ka sang kei hi.
Ahi zongin na sung uhah Pasian' itna na neih loh lam uh ka thei hi.
Ka Pa' min tawh kong pai a, kei nong sang kei uh hi. Midang khat amahmah ii min tawh hong pai leh na sang ding uh hi.
Pasian' kiangpan hong pai minpha lunggulh lo-in khatlekhat na kipiakte uh sang na hih uhleh bangci up theih ding na hi uh hiam?
Pa' kiangah note hong khia ding sakha kei un. Note hong khia khat om a, tua pen na lamet uh ahi Moses ahi hi.
A hang pen Moses in keima' thu na gelh ahih manin amah um hileh uhcin kei nong um ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ama' laigelhte a um lo na hih uhleh keima' thugente zong bangci up theih ding na hi uh hiam?”
